thread:
diego: Hey all, I'm diego, starting on-call shadowing today. Quick access problem: I can see incidents but can't ack them (PD throws a permissions error). Who owns PD groups so I can get added?

rachel: welcome! :tada: Ping @ops-iam for group provisioning. If you're seeing incidents but can't ack, you're probably in the 'oncall-observer' SCIM group only.

josh: FYI the oncall rotation owners are in the runbook (Confluence) under 'Rotations & Escalation'. If you need immediate ack ability, ops-iam can add you to the oncall-users group for the week.

diego: thanks. also, what's our guidance on throttling alerts during traffic spikes? we had a noisy downstream yesterday.

samir: short answer: don't silence broadly. Use the alert's annotation to mark "deploy" or "noisy-downstream" and apply a targeted muting rule for the metric causing noise. Only suppress if you've confirmed no direct customer impact. Runbook excerpt below.

oncall-trainer-bot: QUICK TIP: For latency alerts -> confirm user impact by checking /metrics/service-latency and error budget dashboard before muting.

samir: runbook snippet: ```
MUTING GUIDELINES:
- Check customer-facing dashboards (SLA, errors)
- If impact limited to internal background jobs -> apply metric-level mute for specific job
- If deploy tagged & rollback in progress -> tag incident and follow rollback path, do not mute until rollback proves safe
```

diego: good to know. another setup q: do shadows need the 'oncall-shadow' IAM role or full console access?

rachel: shadows get the 'oncall-shadow' role (read-only + escalate pd). Full console access only for primaries. DM @ops-iam to request the role; include your employee id.

diego: requesting pairing practice — can someone run a short simulated alert flow with me this afternoon? want to practice triage -> escalate -> write a short timeline.

josh: I can run a 25-min mock at 14:30 UTC. We'll simulate a slow degrade of search service and walk through PD escalation + creating a follow-up RFC. Meet in #eng-oncall and I'll invite you.

diego: perfect, appreciate it. last thing: where do we record that a shadow completed training?

oncall-trainer-bot: TRAINING LOG: Shadows should add a line to the 'oncall-training' sheet (Confluence) with date, shadow name, primary they shadowed, and checklist items completed. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/training

samir: also add a note in your personal onboarding doc so your manager can sign off.

diego: copied. will DM @ops-iam now for PD/IAM and see you at 14:30. thanks! :raised_hands:

metrics-bot: Alert: search-service p99 latency crossed 2.5s at 2026-04-05T14:05:00Z (auto)

josh: noted. Good rehearsal data for the mock.

ops-iam: FYI I've provisioned diego with 'oncall-shadow' role and added to oncall-users for the week. Confirm you can ack now.

diego: ack works now, thanks @ops-iam! Ready for the drill. :muscle:
